name: MaidPad
description:
MaidPad is the software cleaning businesses use to run scheduling, teams, invoicing and payroll. This connector lets the owner of a MaidPad account ask questions about their own business in plain language and get answers straight from their live data.

Ask things like "what was my revenue in June?", "who owes me money right now?", "who is working tomorrow?", "how many jobs were cancelled last month?" or "what did we last say to this client?" — and follow up naturally instead of hunting through reports.

What it can read:
• Clients, contact details and account history
• The cleaning schedule, individual jobs and day teams
• Invoices, payments and outstanding balances
• Revenue, expenses, profit and receivables aging
• Payroll runs and what each employee is owed
• Estimates, notes, customer reviews and ratings
• Conversations between the business and its clients

The connector is strictly read-only: Claude can look at your information but cannot create, change or delete anything. It only ever sees the data of the company you are signed in to, and you can disconnect at any time.

Requires a MaidPad account. Sign in with your MaidPad master (owner) login — the same credentials you already use.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MaidPad to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MaidPad to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.maidpad.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MaidPad MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaidPad lists 24 MCP tools, including get_business_metrics, get_chat, get_client, get_client_balances, get_company_info, get_employee_schedule, get_financial_summary, get_invoice, get_job, get_job_reviews, get_payroll, and get_receivables_aging.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MaidPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MaidPad in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
MaidPad requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MaidPad is developed by MaidPad. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
